UNIFORMFORD VICTORFORD CHARLIEFORD

Incident page for this loss

Name: WO1 Victorford Charlieford Uniformford
Reason: explosive device
Unit: 170 AHC
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 11/14/1967; duty: Pilot.
Service: U.S. Army; reserve component; AV branch
Country: South Vietnam
Aircraft: UH-1H tail number 66-16539
Short Summary: A B-40 rocket hit the helicopter in an LZ southwest of Dak To; DOD lists him as a ground casualty.
Location: Kontum Province II Corps.
Primary cause: Hostile Fire
Burial information: SAMPLE MEMORIAL PARK, ANYTOWN
